title: Japanese Yen weakens further against US Dollar as hawkish Fed bets dominate
summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to underperform against the US Dollar (USD), with the USD/JPY pair trading 0.2% higher to near 157.70 during the European session on Wednesday. The pair trades higher due to continued outperformance by the US Dollar.

title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Eyes 1.4100 as bulls retain control near July 29 highs
summary: The USD/CAD pair prolongs its weekly uptrend for the third straight day, hitting a fresh high since July 29 during the early part of the European session on Wednesday. Bulls now await a move beyond the 1.4100 round figure before positioning for further gains amid a supportive fundamental backdrop.

title: Euro nudges up against British Pound with Eurozone and UK PMIs in focus
summary: The Euro (EUR) edges up against the British Pound (GBP) for the second consecutive day on Wednesday, although it remains halfway within recent ranges, with trading volumes at low levels, and investors awaiting Purchasing Managers Index (PMI) data from the UK and the Eurozone.

title: Brent: Price slide extends on pipeline restart – Danske Bank
summary: Danske Research Team notes Brent crude trading near USD 98/bbl after six straight sessions of declines, with Oil acting as the dominant intraday driver for broader markets.
